text:
nina: Kickoff for "Cohort Ignite" email series tied to benchmark webinar + product tips. Need final segment CSV, send windows, and 2 subject variants. Quick alignment here.

leo: For timezone strategy: APAC early, NA mid, EMEA late. Propose local send windows 9am/11am/4pm local respectively.

rachel: Draft segments (CSV ready):
```
segment_id,filter,description
cohort_new_7d,trial_start<=7d,new trialers
cohort_active_21d,last_open<=21d,engaged users
cohort_sleep_150d,last_engagement>150d,reactivation test
```
Exclude users with tag `no_marketing` or unsubscribed in last 30d.

ops_bot: Quota check: daily send cap 900k. Recommend concurrency 180, batch 120. Failover plan: if provider errors > 4% for 3m, switch to backup provider.

nina: Creative: two subject families please. Henry can you draft short preheaders.

henry: Subjects: A) "Redwood benchmarks: speed & cost wins" B) "How we run inference at scale (webinar)". Preheaders: "Register + quick checklist" / "Benchmarks & configs inside".

leo: A/B plan: engaged users 70/30 A/B. Sleep cohort even 50/50. We'll track register rate and webinar conversions.

rachel: Cadence: send1 -> 36h follow-up -> 4-day reminder -> day-after recap. For new trialers shorten to 24h -> 48h.

ops_bot: Please drop segments to s3://marketing/cohort-ignite/segments.csv. Once uploaded, system will schedule job for epoch 2755620000.

leo: Uploaded and checksum posted: s3://marketing/cohort-ignite/segments.csv md5: ab12cd34ef56.

mailgun-bot: File detected at s3://marketing/cohort-ignite/segments.csv. Validating headers and sample size.

ops_bot: Confirming send job: epoch 2755620000. Concurrency 180, batch 120, ramp 12m. Insert RSVP one-question survey for routing. UTM params: utm_campaign=cohort_ignite&utm_source=email.

nina: Also add tag "benchmark_cohort" so Optimize can pull post-send metrics. Schedule debrief Fri 10am PT to review opens, clicks, and register-to-attend.

leo: One more: set soft pause rule for any region with bounce_rate>3% over 20m.

ops_bot: Rule set: pause-region if bounce_rate>3% (20m).

nina: Great — posting final plan to #marketing and pinning. Thanks team! :rocket:
